quotes.text: In your testimony, you cited a study that stated utilizing AI systems would allow the Federal Government to unleash a productivity windfall for the U.S. Government worth up to $532 billion annually [...] Can you describe what kind of productivity gains AI could unlock in the Federal Government and where the big savings are going to come?
I guess part of the lesson should be, the less the government does, the better because they will always screw it up, right? That is what one of the lessons should be.
